newsitem.title: USA: Omnicare revises acquisition price downward.
newsitem.headline: Omnicare revises acquisition price downward.

text.p: Omnicare Inc said Tuesday it has reduced the proposed purchase price of closely-held Coromed Inc,to $15 million in Omnicare common stock from $40 million.

Omnicare said the new price reflected adjustments made to prior year earnings during a subsequent due diligence review and a review of current fiscal year operating results which have been hurt by timing differences between the completion of two large clinical studies and delays in the commencement of anticipated new studies.
Omnicare added that expenses related to the acquisition will be recognized as a one-time charge and that its financial statements will not be restated for the merger.

The transaction, which is subject to the approval of Coromed shareholders and the satisfaction of certain other conditions, was expected to close within ninety days, said Omnicare. Excluding transaction-related expenses, the acquisition was expected to be nondilutive to 1997 earnings.
